title: Phase 5 TDD test cases - relationship-graph representability specification
purpose: Consumed by the future graph engine (get_start_seeds / get_neighbours). GREEN cases must pass once the engine exists; RED cases define the Phase 5 edge work and are expected to FAIL until that work is implemented. No semantic inference is permitted - all traversals are deterministic structural joins.
accepted_limitations: Inherent attribute -> derived-stat grant APPLICATION (Int->Mana, Str->Melee/Armour, Dex->Accuracy/Evasion) is client-side and absent from the export. The stat DEFINITIONS exist (e.g. stat:maximum_mana_+_per_2_intelligence, stat:bonus_accuracy_rating_+_from_dexterity) plus negations/overrides, but no record applies them to characters. The graph cannot prove the inherent application; do not fake it.

test_cases.goal: Strength -> FireMin/FireMax head must be traversable
test_cases.phase5_requirement: WHAT: a deterministic relationship must connect stat:strength to the per-strength fire scaling stats, derived only from the source stat-id strings. Classification: representable - the stat ids exist in the data; the head link is not yet connected.

assertions.detail: stat:strength is reachable from the per-10-strength fire stats within depth 2
no semantic inference / no display-text parsing

test_cases.goal: Endurance Charge -> FireMin/FireMax head must be traversable
test_cases.phase5_requirement: WHAT: a start entity for 'Endurance Charge' and a deterministic relationship from it to the per-charge fire stats are required. Classification: data gap - no node currently represents endurance charges; the damage side is representable.

assertions.detail: a start entity for 'Endurance Charge' exists and connects to the per-charge fire stats within depth 2
must not fake a node - report the entity decision explicitly

test_cases.phase5_requirement: WHAT: a validated, deterministic unique->mod association for unique:739 must be establishable. Classification: validation gap - current associations are unvalidated method-2 text candidates and must not become relationships until validated.

assertions.detail: unique:739 has >=1 resolved_target with method in {1,3,4} (verified, validated) - currently none
method-2 candidates must not be traversable as confirmed relations

test_cases.goal: Whispers -> Intelligence -> Lightning-per-Int -> Lightning -> Unholy Trinity multi-hop discovery
test_cases.phase5_requirement: WHAT: each hop (Whispers->mana->Intelligence->Lightning-per-Int->Lightning->Unholy Trinity) must be a deterministic relationship. Classification: Whispers resolution is unvalidated (validation gap); the Intelligence<->scaling-stat hops are representable from the source stat-id strings but not yet connected; the inherent Int->mana application is an accepted data gap.

assertions.detail: a depth-limited traversal from unique:1461 reaches gem:SupportUnholyTrinity via stat:intelligence and lightning-damage stats
each hop is a real edge (M1/M2/M3/M4), not a lookup shortcut
the quantitative variance hypothesis is NOT asserted - only that all structural info is reachable
